custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English-Wizard.question: ১) Kamal said, "I shall start the project next week." (make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: Kamal said that he shall start the project next week.
English-Wizard.option2: Kamal requested that he would start the project next week.
English-Wizard.option3: Kamal said that he would start the project the following week.
English-Wizard.option4: Kamal said that he will be starting the project next week.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Direct Speech এ Reported Verb টি Past Tense হলে Indirect Speech এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Reporting Speech এর Subject বসে।
- Reporting Verb say/ said, tell/ told বসবে। (যদি থাকে)
- Inverted Comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসে।
- Reported Speech এর Subject/ Person অনুসারে পরিবর্তন হবে।
- Future Tense এর Will/Shall এর পরিবর্তে Would ব্যবহার করা হয়।
- বাকী অংশ বসে।

• Direct Speech: Kamal said, "I shall start the project next week."
• Indirect Speech: Kamal said that he would start the project the following week.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ২) Rahim said, "I must finish the work today." (make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: Rahim said that he must finish the work today.
English-Wizard.option2: Rahim said that he had to finish the work that day.
English-Wizard.option3: Rahim said that he has to finish the work today.
English-Wizard.option4: Rahim said that he finished the work that day.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Direct specch থেকে Indirect specch এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Reporting verb এর Subject বসে এবং তারপর Reporting verb (say/ said, tell/ told) বসে (যদি থাকে)।
- যদি assertive sentence হয়, তাহলে Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসানো হয়।
- Reported speech এর person পরিবর্তন করতে হয়।
- Reporting verb এর Subject বা Object এর number (একবচন বা বহুবচন), person (first, second, third) এবং gender (male/ female) অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তন হয়।
- যখন Reported Verb past হয়, তখন must → had to হবে।
- তারপর বাক্যটির বাকি অংশ বসানো হয়।

• Direct speech: Rahim said, "I must finish the work today."
• Indirect speech: Rahim said that he had to finish the work that day.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ৩) We'd seen that movie before, ________?
English-Wizard.option1: wouldn't we
English-Wizard.option2: had we
English-Wizard.option3: would we
English-Wizard.option4: hadn't we
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• Confusing Contraction sentence এর tag question করার নিয়ম:
- যদি subject এরপর 'd থাকে অর্থাৎ, verb টি base form এ আসে, তাহলে এটিকে modal auxiliary হিসেবে would ধরতে হবে।
- Example: If I were a rich man, I'd establish a hospital, wouldn't I?

- তবে 'd এরপরের verb টি যদি past participle form এ থাকে তাহলে তাকে past perfect tense এর had হিসেবে ধরতে হবে।
- Example: I'd reached there in time, hadn't I?

• Correct answer: We'd seen that movie before, hadn't we?

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ৪) "Why have you beaten my dog"? He said to me. (Make it Indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: He demanded me why had I beaten his dog.
English-Wizard.option2: He asked me why I have had beaten his dog.
English-Wizard.option3: He enquired me why had I had beaten his dog.
English-Wizard.option4: He demanded of me why I had beaten his dog.
English-Wizard.exp:
• (38 BCS Preli Question)

• WH-Question যুক্ত Direct speech কে Indirect Speech এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Reporting Verb হিসেবে tense অনুযায়ী ask/ asked, enquire of/ enquired of, want/ wanted to know, demanded ইত্যাদি ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- WH-word টি (যেমন: Why, how, what, where) অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে।
- Direct speech -এর Past Indefinite tense, Past Perfect tense -এ পরিবর্তিত হবে।
- Person পরিবর্তন করতে হবে (You → I).
- Interrogative sentence টি Indirect speech - এ সবসময় assertive  sentence -এ পরিণত হবে।

• বাক্যটি দ্বারা দৃঢ় ভাবে জিজ্ঞাসা করা বোঝাচ্ছে।
- আর demand of somebody অর্থ কাউকে দৃঢ় ভাবে জিজ্ঞাসা করা।
- আর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Present Perfect থাকলে Past Perfect হয়।
- বাক্যটিকে Assertive এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হবে এবং এ হিসেবে Auxiliary Verb - Subject এর পরে বসবে।

• Direct Speech: "Why have you beaten my dog"? He said to me.
• Indirect Speech: He demanded of me why I had beaten his dog.

English-Wizard.question: ৫) Someone should help him, ______?
English-Wizard.option1: shouldn't they
English-Wizard.option2: shouldn't it
English-Wizard.option3: should they
English-Wizard.option4: shouldn't him
English-Wizard.exp:
• Statement টি affirmative হলে, এবং তার subject হিসেবে everyone, everybody, somebody (কেউ, কোন একজন), someone- এদের যে কোন একটি ব্যবহার করা হলে tag- এ not ব্যবহার হবে।
- Tag question এর subject হিসেবে They বসবে।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative হবে।
- তাই এখানে shouldn't they হবে।

• Complete Sentence: Someone should help him, shouldn't they?

Source: A Passage to the English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question: ৬) She said, "Alas! I have lost my purse." (make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: She said that she had lost her purse.
English-Wizard.option2: She exclaimed with joy that she has lost her purse.
English-Wizard.option3: She exclaimed with sorrow that she had lost her purse.
English-Wizard.option4: She exclaimed sadly that she lost her purse.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Exclamatory Sentence এর Direct Speech এ আনন্দ/ দুঃখ বুঝালে Indirect Speech এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Subject + Reporting Verb পরিবর্তিত হয়ে (আনন্দ বুঝালে) exclaim/ exclaimed with joy বসে এবং (দুঃখ বুঝালে) exclaim/ exclaimed with sorrow or grief বসে।
- Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসে।
- Reported speech এর Subject বসে।
- Reporting verb অনুযায়ী Reported speech এর verb বসবে।
- Adjective বসবে।
- বাকি অংশ (যদি থাকে)।

• Direct Speech: She said, "Alas! I have lost my purse."
• Indirect Speech: She exclaimed with sorrow that she had lost her purse.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) Let’s play football in the evening, ______?
English-Wizard.option1: will we
English-Wizard.option2: shan't we
English-Wizard.option3: shall they
English-Wizard.option4: shall we
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• Let যুক্ত imperative sentence এর tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Let এরপর 's থাকেলে বুঝতে হবে যে 's দ্বারা us কে বুঝানো হয়েছে।
- Us এর পরিবর্তে We ব্যবহার করা হয়।
- Tag question এ shall we বসে।

• Complete Sentence: Let’s play football in the evening, shall we?

Source: A Passage to the English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) Ali has said to his friend, "I shall attend the meeting and you will come later." (Make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: Ali has told his friend that he will attend the meeting and he will come later.
English-Wizard.option2: Ali has told his friend that he would attend the meeting and he should come later.
English-Wizard.option3: Ali has told his friend that he should attend the meeting and he would come later.
English-Wizard.option4: Ali told his friend that he will attend the meeting and he will come later.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Direct Speech থাকে Indirect Speech এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Direct Speech এ Reporting Verb এর Tense যদি Present tense বা Future Tense হয় তখন Indirect Speech এ Tense এর কোন পরিবর্তন হবে না।
- Inverted Comma এর পরিবর্তে that বসে।
- Reported Speech এর Person এর পরিবর্তন হয়।

• Direct Speech: Ali has said to his friend, "I shall attend the meeting and you will come later."
• Indirect Speech: Ali has told his friend that he will attend the meeting and he will come later.

Source: A Passage To The English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) He seldom goes to the cinema, ______?
English-Wizard.option1: doesn't he
English-Wizard.option2: does he
English-Wizard.option3: do he
English-Wizard.option4: did he
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative হবে এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• No one, Nobody, Nothing, Scarcely, Barely, Hardly, Seldom ইত্যাদি যুক্ত sentence এর Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Statement এ যদি neither, none, no one, nobody, nothing, scarcely, barely, hardly, hardly ever, seldom এদের যে কোন একটি word থাকে তাহলে এটি negative statement হিসেবে ধরা হয়।
- এরা negative অর্থ প্রকাশ করে।
- এদের পরবর্তী Tag এ এজন্য not বসে না।
- auxiliary verb না থাকলে, মূল verb এর tense ও person অনুযায়ী verb ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- এখানে 'goes' হলো third person singular number (He) এর verb, তাই tag question টি does he?

• Complete Sentence: He seldom goes to the cinema, does he? 

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১০) The mother said to her son, "Eat your food properly." (Make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: The mother advised her son to eat his food properly
English-Wizard.option2: The mother told her son eat his food properly.
English-Wizard.option3: The mother requested her son eating his food properly.
English-Wizard.option4: The mother said her son to eat his food properly.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Imperative sentence এর Direct speech কে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তর এর নিয়ম:
- Subject + request/ order/ advice/ beg/ forbid বসে।
- Object বসে।
- to + reported speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসবে।
- নিয়মানুযায়ী person পরিবর্তিত হবে।
- reported verb টি অনুরোধ বুঝালে request, আদেশ বুঝালে order/ command, উপদেশ বুঝালে advise, অন্যথায় tell দ্বারা পরিবর্তিত হবে।

• Direct speech: The mother said to her son, "Eat your food properly."
• Indirect speech: The mother advised her son to eat his food properly

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১১) Let him do the work, ______?
English-Wizard.option1: are you
English-Wizard.option2: shall you
English-Wizard.option3: will you
English-Wizard.option4: do you
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative হবে এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• সাধারণত imperative sentence এ let me/ him/ her/ them দ্বারা শুরু হলে tag question এ will you বসে।

• Correct answer: Let him do the work, will you?

English-Wizard.question: ১২) The teacher said to the students, "Open your books." (make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: The teacher told the students open their books.
English-Wizard.option2: The teacher ordered the students to open their books.
English-Wizard.option3: The teacher said the students to open their books.
English-Wizard.option4: The teacher requested the students opening their books.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Imperative sentence এর Direct speech কে Indirect speech এ রূপান্তর এর নিয়ম:
- Subject + request/ order/ advice/ beg/ forbid বসে।
- Object বসে।
- to + reported speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসবে।
- নিয়মানুযায়ী person পরিবর্তিত হবে।
- reported verb টি অনুরোধ বুঝালে request, আদেশ বুঝালে order/ command, উপদেশ বুঝালে advise, অন্যথায় tell দ্বারা পরিবর্তিত হবে।

• Direct speech: The teacher said to the students, "Open your books."
• Indirect speech: The teacher ordered the students to open their books.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) We rarely go out during exams, ______?
English-Wizard.option1: don't we
English-Wizard.option2: did we
English-Wizard.option3: do we
English-Wizard.option4: does we
English-Wizard.exp:
• Correct sentence: We rarely go out during exams, do we?

• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লেখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
- Tag question এর subject সর্বদা মূল sentence এর subject এর pronoun হয়।
- Tag question গঠনে auxiliary verb ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং auxiliary verb এর সংক্ষিপ্ত রূপ হয়।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টা negative হবে। আবার statement negative হলে tag question positive হবে।

• hardly, rarely, scarcely, seldom ইত্যাদি কোনো sentence এ থাকলে, ওই sentence "negative' expression দেয়।
- এর ফলে প্রশ্ন প্রদও বাক্যটির tag 'affirmative' হয়েছে।
- Sentence টিতে subject We হওয়ার কারণে Auxiliary verb 'do' হয়েছে।
- অর্থাৎ, Tag question এর নিয়মানুযায়ী বাক্যটি Negative হওয়ায় Tag question Affirmative হয়েছে।

Source: Advanced Learner's Grammar and Composition by Chowdhury and Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) Maya said to her friend, "Let’s go to the park tomorrow." (make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: Maya told her friend that they go to the park tomorrow.
English-Wizard.option2: Maya suggested to her friend that they should go to the park the next day.
English-Wizard.option3: Maya requested her friend that they go to the park tomorrow.
English-Wizard.option4: Maya proposed to her friend that they should go to the park yesterday.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Let যুক্ত sentence এর indirect করার নিয়ম:
- Let এরপর us থাকলে indirect করার সময় reporting verb টি পরিবর্তিত হয়ে propose / suggest হয়। 
- Inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসে।
- they/ we + should বসে।
- Reported Speech এর মুল verb থাকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।
- Reporting verb এর Subject third person হলে that এরপরে they বসে, এবং Reporting verb এর subject first person হলে that এরপরে we বসে।

• Direct speech: Maya said to her friend, "Let’s go to the park tomorrow."
• Indirect speech: Maya suggested to her friend that they should go to the park the next day.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) She has submitted her assignments on time, ________?
English-Wizard.option1: hasn't she
English-Wizard.option2: haven't she
English-Wizard.option3: did she
English-Wizard.option4: doesn't she
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি Negative হবে এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে Auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• Tag question এর নিয়মানুযায়ী বাক্যটি Affirmative হওয়ায় Tag question Negative হবে।
- বাক্যটি Past Present perfect Tense হওয়ায় Tag question এর ক্ষেত্রে hasn't হবে।
- Subject হিসেবে she আছে, তাই শুন্যস্থানে hasn't she হবে।

• Correct Sentence: She has submitted her assignments on time, hasn't she?

Source: A Passage to the English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) She said, "May Allah give me strength to face the challenge." (Make it narration)
English-Wizard.option1: She wished that Allah may give her strength to face the challenge.
English-Wizard.option2: She prayed that Allah may give me strength to face the challenge.
English-Wizard.option3: She wished that Allah might to give her strength to face the challenge.
English-Wizard.option4: She prayed that Allah might give her strength to face the challenge.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Optative Sentence এর Direct speech থাকে Indirect speech- এ রূপান্তর এর নিয়ম:
- reporting clause এর subject বসে।
- reporting verb এর পরিবর্তে (wish/wished)/ (pray/prayed) বসে।
- inverted comma উঠে গিয়ে that বসে।
- reported speech এর subject বসে।
- may/ might বসে।
- reported speech এর মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত বসে।

• Direct speech: She said, "May Allah give me strength to face the challenge."
• Indirect speech: She prayed that Allah might give her strength to face the challenge. 

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) I need some books, _______?
English-Wizard.option1: do I
English-Wizard.option2: don't I
English-Wizard.option3: needn't I
English-Wizard.option4: need I
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• Sub + need/ needs/ needed থাকলে tag question এ don't/ doesn't/ didn't হবে, কখনোই needn't হবে না।
- don't/ doesn't/ didn't need থাকলে do/ does/ did হবে।
- শুধুমাত্র needn't থাকলে need হবে।

• Complete Sentence: I need some books, don't I?

Source: A Passage to the English Language S. M. Zakir Hussain, Live MCQ English Wizard.

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) Rafi said to his brother, "Where have you kept my book?" (Make it indirect)
English-Wizard.option1: Rafi asked his brother where had he kept his book.
English-Wizard.option2: Rafi asked his brother where he had kept his book.
English-Wizard.option3: Rafi asked his brother where have you kept his book.
English-Wizard.option4: afi asked his brother where he has kept his book.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Interrogative sentence (Direct speech) কে Assertive sentence (Indirect speech)- এ রূপান্তর এর নিয়ম: 
- উল্লিখিত বাক্যটি wh question যুক্ত।
- wh question যুক্ত বাক্যের indirect speech এ 'said to' এর পরিবর্তে 'asked' বসে।
- Reported speech -এর Wh word অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে। অর্থাৎ, সেই Wh-question word টিই conjunction হিসেবে বসবে।
- তারপর Reported speech এর subject বসবে।
- Direct speech টি present perfect tense এ থাকলে Indirect speech এ, তা past perfect tense এ পরিণত হবে।
- তারপর বাকি অংশ বসবে।

• Direct speech: Rafi said to his brother, "Where have you kept my book?"
• Indirect speech: Rafi asked his brother where he had kept his book.

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) I ought to complain, ________?
English-Wizard.option1: should I
English-Wizard.option2: don't I
English-Wizard.option3: oughtn't I
English-Wizard.option4: won't I
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- Tag question ব্যবহার করা হয় উক্তিটি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত করার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question হয়।

• used to বাক্যের auxiliary verb হিসেবে ব্যবহার হলে tag question এ didn't/ usedn't বসে।
- ought to বাক্যের auxiliary verb হিসেবে ব্যবহার হলে tag question এ oughtn't/ shouldn't বসে।
- প্রদত্ত sentence টিতে auxiliary verb হিসেবে ought to ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।
- তাই, tag question এ এখানে oughtn't এবং subject হিসেবে I ব্যবহার হবে।

• Correct sentence: I ought to complain, oughtn't I?

English-Wizard.question: ২০) She wrote a letter to her friend last week, ______?
English-Wizard.option1: didn't she
English-Wizard.option2: didn't he
English-Wizard.option3: didn't they
English-Wizard.option4: didn't it
English-Wizard.exp:
• Tag question করার নিয়ম:
- সাধারণত Tag question ব্যবহৃত হয় পূর্বে উল্লেখিত কোন উক্তি সত্য না মিথ্যা তা নিশ্চিত হওয়ার জন্য।
- Statement positive হলে tag question টি negative এবং negative হলে positive হবে।
- Subject ও Tense অনুসারে auxiliary verb দ্বারা tag question তৈরি হয়।

- যেহেতু প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি affirmative এ আছে, তাই  Tag question Negative হবে এবং বাক্যটি past tense হওয়ায় Subject ও Tense অনুসারে এবং verb singular এবং subject টি 3rd person singular হওয়ায় Tag question এর ক্ষেত্রে didn't হবে।

• Correct answer: She wrote a letter to her friend last week, didn't she?

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.
